modules.live_check: V3LUM_LIVE=1 tests/live/test_p1_g10_3.py::test_natural_person_registries_parse_and_an_invented_name_is_not_found PASSED: both natural-person registries downloaded and validated (> 1,000 rows each); an invented name with a recorded purpose -> EMPTY (no real person was searched).

core_requests: v3lum.core.datasets.DatasetInfo: expose last_modified (and etag) of the local copy, so CVM copies are dated by the source's Last-Modified instead of the download date (P360 FC2; today every copy reads 'as of <fetched date>').

Policy POL-14 / register_dataset: optional datasets (e.g. register_dataset(..., optional=True) or Module.optional_datasets) so a missing secondary dataset (one CVM registry on a first install) degrades coverage instead of making bcb_authorized_institutions UNAVAILABLE 'dataset' in scans; DominiosVerificados alone is enough for domain matching.

DataStore.update_all / v3lum data update: on-demand datasets skipped unless named or needed by a selected module, for the natural-person registries cvm_adm_cart_pf.csv and cvm_consultor_vlmob_pf.csv (LGPD minimisation, P360 FC9); today a plain `v3lum data update` stores them.

register_dataset(validate=...): pass the previous copy's DatasetInfo (or the runtime clock) to the callback; copy validators that compare with the installed copy (P360 FC2: row count within -10%/+25%) must re-read it through DataStore(None) and date it with the wall clock.

P302 scoring: apply v3lum.modules.brazil_public_data.bcb_authorized_institutions.reputation_adjustment() to domain/URL nodes carrying known_good / verified_fi (domain-reputation kinds x0.5, malicious verdicts kept at 1.0, URL-level hits untouched, nothing suppressed) - P360 FC5.

core/vocab.py: broaden the description of attribute known_good beyond hashes ('bool: known benign: a hash in a known-software set, or a domain verified by an official registry'); P360 FC4 sets it on domains and URLs.

WP27 golden-path harness: pre-seed local dataset copies so offline dataset modules (bcb_authorized_institutions ships empty routes for domain/url/cnpj: it never sends a request during a scan) are exercised instead of reading UNAVAILABLE 'dataset'.

P012 typosquat owner (cross-batch): carry cnpj_root/owner_cnpj_root of the protected BCB entry in lookalike_matches and call bcb_authorized_institutions.classify_lookalike() for BCB entries of forward scans (P360 FC8); the graph rule bcb_lookalike_activity covers reverse matches meanwhile.

tests/test_datasets.py::test_first_run_hint_and_update_all (core test) is order-dependent: its autouse fixture _isolated_registry restores DATASETS after the test but never clears it before, so any module imported earlier that registers essential datasets (other batches' attack*, nicbr_asn_blk.txt, and this batch's bcb_*/cvm_* company sets) breaks "'core.txt' in hint" and update_all(essential_only=True) == ['core.txt'] (it passes alone). Fix: saved = dict(DATASETS); DATASETS.clear(); yield; DATASETS.clear(); DATASETS.update(saved).

tests/modules/test_typosquat.py::test_bcb_rows_and_dataset_discovery (batch p1-G01-2, P012), line 270, asserts the pre-P360 message 'BCB DominiosVerificados list not installed'. Now that P360 registers bcb_dominios_verificados.json (source bcb.olinda_institutions, the very registration typosquat._bcb_dataset is designed to discover), the function correctly answers 'BCB DominiosVerificados (bcb_dominios_verificados.json) not downloaded: run v3lum data update bcb_dominios_verificados.json'. Fix for the file owner/integrator: run that assertion with the P360 entry filtered out (monkeypatch.setattr(TS._datasets, 'DATASETS', {k: v for k, v in TS._datasets.DATASETS.items() if v.get('source') != 'bcb.olinda_institutions'})) or assert the 'not downloaded' form; tests/modules/test_bcb_authorized_institutions.py::test_typosquat_discovers_the_protected_brand_dataset covers the integrated path.
No MODULE_GUIDE section 25 name was needed (the batch uses only contract v2 and the wave-2 names: datasets, policy gate, lint).
notes: P360 is delivered as bcb_authorized_institutions (default-on, disclosure 'none': the investigated value never leaves the machine), the opt-in due-diligence module cvm_person_registry, the shared CVM loader cvm_registries.py (no Module class; meant for P361 and P244: parse_cvm_csv, cvm_status, NameIndex, load_companies, load_people, copy_validator, cia_aberta parse support - not registered, see backlog) and the correlation pack v3lum/correlations/p1_g10_3.py. FC1: 5 Olinda sets + 4 CVM company registries registered with large=True, essential=True, ttl 24 h (CVM zips extract only the registry member: the resp/diretor/socios people lists are never stored); the module reads local copies only (a TTL that never refreshes), so nothing is downloaded during a scan or `v3lum run`; a missing copy is UNAVAILABLE 'dataset' (policy POL-14 in scans). FC2: copy_validator rejects copies below the floors, outside -10%/+25% of the previous copy (relative check dropped once the installed copy is a week old) or with < 400 unique verified domains; the dataset date is in evidence, findings, the dataset_age attribute and the coverage rows (source_status). FC3: provider extension bcb__p1-G10-3.json adds the marker bcb_authorized_institutions_odata_comment_error (any status) with the byte-exact fixture; parsers also fail closed. FC4: core PSL, exact host or label-wise subdomain below the registrable domain, nested verified domains most specific first; known_good + INFO finding (legal name, CNPJ root, segment, conglomerate, tags verified_fi/known_good). FC5: the module never touches other findings; rule bcb_verified_domain_flagged yields 'possible compromise - verified institution domain, review URL' (medium/possible); reputation_adjustment() is the helper for the P302 scorer (core request). FC6: redirect targets in query/fragment (encoded, scheme-relative, backslash, base64, bare hosts with an IANA TLD) -> not known_good, finding 'Redirect via verified domain' (medium/possible, tag redirect_via_verified_domain), targets pivoted as domains (expand). Also flags a verified domain used as URL userinfo. FC7: no match = EMPTY with no finding; an authorised institution without a verified domain gets only the INFO line. FC8: protected_brands/protected_brand_for/classify_lookalike feed + rule bcb_lookalike_activity (typosquat reverse matches; HIGH registered+active via A/AAAA not parked, MX or a first certificate <= 30 days; MEDIUM watch item; defensive and conglomerate registrations suppressed; silent without brand facts); typosquat (P012) already discovers the DominiosVerificados dataset by source+URL (tested). FC9: one-line answer attribute bcb_cvm_authorisation, exact normalised legal/trade names only, <= 5 hypotheses, CNPJ auto-chaining only on a unique exact legal name of an active entity, CPF-shaped input refused; natural-person registries only in cvm_person_registry (default off, run_on seeds, recorded purpose, exact full name of >= 2 words, never a CPF, POSSIBLE + context_only, no pivots, separate provider source cvm.cvm_person_registry_pf so its optional datasets never gate the main module). FC10: providers bcb and cvm are trusted (registry); the derived Module.trust_tier is 'n/a' because disclosure is 'none'; attribution in findings, evidence and dataset registrations; betting operators in the backlog. LIGHT/ACTIVE: none (FC8's live-page signal waits for the LIGHT phase, backlogged). Fixtures: trimmed real DominiosVerificados/Sedes/CVM rows (contacts -> contato@example.com, phones 5555-01xx), the byte-exact comment-wrapped Olinda error body, a truncated cia_aberta download, synthetic natural-person rows with invalid CPF-shaped digits; rule graph fixtures for both rules. Concurrent sibling batches (G10-1, G10-2) write other files into v3lum/modules/brazil_public_data/; none uses this batch's sources.
